senses.gloss:
Peddana
of the Kāśyapa family, of Liṅgamaguṇṭapaṭṭaṇa; great grandfather of Rāmakavi (a. of Śṛṅgārarasodayabhāṇa, IO. 7427).

Peddanārya
father of Māmiḍi Śiṅgaya or Nṛsim3ha (a. of C. Gūḍhārthadīpikā on Somasiddhānta, MT. 1715).

Peddamalla
of Penugoṇḍa family; father of Somanātha (a. of (Smṛtisarva) Sam3śayoddhāra, MT. 1938 (c)).

Peddayārya
or Peddācārya or Peḍḍārya. son of Kolācala Mallinātha an. elder brother of Kumārasvāmin (a. of C. Ratnāpaṇa on Pratāparudrīya, IO. 1176. MT. 1143 (a.).

Peddasūri
son of Cennubhaṭṭa.
--C. Kaumudī on Mahimnaḥstava of Puṣpadanta. Adyar D. IV. 1045. Extr. p. 170. MT. 1645 (a. (Buddhisūri).

Peddibhaṭṭa
of Vāsiṣṭhagotra. patron of Nāgeśa (a. of Kāṇvaśākhāmahimasaṅgraha, MT. 2389). [Page196-a.

Peddibhaṭṭa
alias Mallinātha. Wrongly given a. brother of Mallinātha by Nārāyaṇapaṇḍita, a. descendant of Kolācala family in his C. Padayojanā on Campūrāmāyaṇa, MD. 12281. See Intro. p. 14. to Ekāvalī, Osmania Uni. edn. 1981.

Peddibhaṭṭa
of the family of Mahāmahopādhyāya of Eleśvarapura.
--Sūktivāridhi. anthology in 13 śatakas. MD. 12143. MT. 5594.

Peddi(dda)bhaṭṭa
of Kauśikagotra. father of Viśveśvara Bhaṭṭa (a. of Madanapārijāta, IO. 1394 an. Mahārṇava, MT. 53).
